1:
SELECT DISTINCT e."name", e."event_space"
FROM "eventspaces" e
WHERE (LOWER(e."event_space") LIKE '%banquet hall%'
       OR LOWER(e."event_space") LIKE '%conference room%')
  AND CAST(e."capacity" AS INTEGER) >= 200;
3:
SELECT DISTINCT
    r."name" AS restaurant_name,
    r."food_service"
FROM
    "restaurants" r
WHERE
    LOWER(r."cuisine") LIKE '%italian%'
4:
SELECT DISTINCT
    r."id",
    r."name",
    r."address",
    r."food_service",
    r."cuisine"
FROM
    "restaurants" r
WHERE
    r."food_service" LIKE '%Restaurant%'
    OR (r."food_service" LIKE '%Café%' AND r."cuisine" LIKE '%Italian%');
6:
SELECT DISTINCT "s"."name", "s"."role", "s"."language"
FROM "staff" AS "s"
WHERE LOWER("s"."role") LIKE '%chef%'
   OR (LOWER("s"."role") LIKE '%server%' AND LOWER("s"."language") LIKE '%english%');
8:
SELECT DISTINCT
    s1."name" AS chef_name,
    s1."language" AS chef_language,
    s2."name" AS server_name,
    s2."language" AS server_language
FROM
    "staff" s1
JOIN
    "staff" s2 ON s1."language" = s2."language"
WHERE
    s1."role" LIKE '%Chef%'
    AND s2."role" LIKE '%Server%'
    AND s1."language" LIKE '%English%';
111:
SELECT DISTINCT
    its."name" AS it_specialist_name,
    s."system_name",
    s."is_active"
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" itss ON its."id" = itss."it_specialist_id"
JOIN
    "systems" s ON itss."system_id" = s."system_id"
ORDER BY
    its."name", s."system_name";
112:
SELECT DISTINCT r."responsibility"
FROM "responsibilities" r
JOIN "internships_responsibilities" ir ON r."id" = ir."responsibilityid"
WHERE (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i."id")
    FROM "internships" i
    JOIN "internships_responsibilities" ir2 ON i."id" = ir2."internshipid"
    WHERE ir2."responsibilityid" = r."id"
) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "internships");
113:
SELECT DISTINCT
    i."id" AS internship_id,
    i."title" AS internship_title,
    r."responsibility" AS responsibility
FROM
    "internships" i
JOIN
    "internships_responsibilities" ir ON i."id" = ir."internshipid"
JOIN
    "responsibilities" r ON ir."responsibilityid" = r."id"
ORDER BY
    i."id";
114:
SELECT DISTINCT
    its."id" AS specialist_id,
    its."name" AS specialist_name,
    s."system_name"
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" itss ON its."id" = itss."it_specialist_id"
JOIN
    "systems" s ON itss."system_id" = s."system_id"
ORDER BY
    its."id", s."system_name";
263:
SELECT DISTINCT sd."hourly_rate"
FROM "salarydetails" sd
JOIN "position" p ON sd."positionid" = p."id"
WHERE LOWER(p."title") LIKE '%software developer%';
264:
SELECT DISTINCT
    p."title" AS job_position,
    sd."salary_range" AS salary_range
FROM
    "position" p
JOIN
    "salarydetails" sd ON p."id" = sd."positionid";
265:
WITH max_salary_job AS (
    SELECT
        "jobid",
        "salary"
    FROM
        "jobs"
    ORDER BY
        "salary" DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    j."preferred_years"
FROM
    "jobs" j
JOIN
    max_salary_job msj ON j."jobid" = msj."jobid";
267:
SELECT DISTINCT
    s."city" AS city,
    t."officelocation" AS street_address
FROM
    "teachers" t
JOIN
    "students" s ON TRUE
WHERE
    t."officelocation" IS NOT NULL
    AND s."city" IS NOT NULL;
